I can’t open or read the file right now — you said no PDF/web tools are available and I don’t see an attachment. I won’t invent page numbers or quotes. If you want page-level citations for the report’s emissions targets, please either:

- Attach/upload the annual report PDF to this chat, or
- Paste the report pages (or the target passages) you want cited, or
- Tell me the exact page range to inspect if you paste the extracted text from those pages.

If you want to extract the citations yourself, here are quick, reliable steps and a citation template you can use.

How to find emissions targets in a PDF (manual, simple)
1. Open the PDF in any viewer (Adobe Reader, Preview, Chrome/Edge).
2. Use Find (Ctrl/Cmd+F) and search these keywords (try each): emissions, emission, greenhouse gas, GHG, Scope 1, Scope 2, Scope 3, tCO2e, carbon, net zero, science-based target, SBTi, reduction target, 2030, 2050, baseline.
3. For each hit, note the page number shown by your viewer.
4. Copy the full sentence or paragraph around the keyword (include any table or figure caption).
5. If the target is in a table/figure, note the table/figure number and caption plus the page.

Command-line option (if comfortable)
- pdftotext report.pdf - | grep -inE "emission|greenhouse|ghg|scope 1|scope 2|scope 3|tco2e|net zero|SBTi|2030|2050"
- Then map results to page numbers with pdftotext -layout and check the viewer.

Citation format (use this template for each item)
- Page X — [exact quoted sentence or table caption]. Context: (section title or table/figure # if present). Example: Page 42 — "By 2030 we will reduce Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 50% from a 2019 baseline." (Environment — Emissions targets; Table 3)

What I can do once you provide the PDF or pasted pages
- Produce a page-by-page list of every emissions target found, with exact quotes, page numbers, and context (section/table/figure).
- Flag ambiguous items (e.g., targets expressed as goals without baseline or date).
- Format the citations in whichever style you prefer (bullet list, CSV, or a short table).

Next step
- Upload the PDF here or paste the relevant pages/text, and I’ll extract and return page-level citations for every emissions target.
